links.outcome: Chatbot accuracy in matching responses to user intents as COVID-19 information evolved
links.effect: Accuracy ranged from 54% to 91.1%; it lagged when new information emerged (e.g., Delta variant) and increased after new content was added.
links.quote: Accuracy lagged when new information related to COVID emerged, such as that related to the Delta variant.

unlisted_practices: Regularly reviewing user queries and reclassifying responses to better match intents
Using communication-theory-guided persuasive messaging to promote vaccination

screen.reason: Evaluates a patient-facing conversational AI chatbot deployed across healthcare settings to promote COVID-19 vaccination, assessing user engagement, topics, and intent-matching accuracy.
